# Fictional native civilian QA exports

These two gzip files preserve exact JSON exported through the actual public
v0.55.1 UI while playing a fictional fresh Standard adult civilian life. They
are prepared QA data, not user personal data or real-player saves. Compression
uses deterministic gzip without changing the decompressed JSON bytes.

- `native-v0551-civilian-fresh.json.gz`: day6571, before the Scholar commission.
  Original ignored artifact: `artifacts/native-v0551-observed/izren-fresh-day6571.json`.
  Original size: 1,028,551 bytes, SHA256
  `acdeaaf1d6a149a8f53d73fc44b9832c117dd853a27ecd38aa6b77b1de8bdf89`.
- `native-v0551-civilian-deferred.json.gz`: day6576, AFTER choosing Return after
  preparing. The real customer is Vezhumo sa Razhumelle, with one actual delivered
  commission and a deferred request. All materials are zero, gold120. Original
  ignored artifact: `artifacts/native-v0551-observed/izren-post-work-event-day6576.json`.
  Original size: 1,041,775 bytes, SHA256
  `354c1c451a3d17d44e747844d9240e45a83cc80620e7412c4c45c056b4f76f1a`.

NO export captured the failed Teach click or its exact pending antecedent. The
post-deferral save proves its own later inventory/state, not that missing wood
was the exact earlier rejection. A controlled old-generic pending fixture in
the helper is labeled separately; it must not be described as native-captured.

New source tests start from the fresh exported life and use real offered Scholar
entry, commission, production, invoice, preparation, materials purchase and
revisit actions. No wood, gold, health, profession or completed work is injected.
Minimal pure admission negatives are explicitly synthetic and are not legal-save
or earned-play claims. This coverage is not unaided native discovery, a whole
life, physical iOS, assistive technology, or global reliability certification.
